race.comment: PUNCH LANE (2) Hawkesbury Cup winner last year who will prove hard to run down despite drawing out. Was a month between runs when he finished a respectable fourth over 1500m at Rosehill in the LR Winter Challenge. Since fitted with a 1000m Rosehill trial on August 7, go close. NELLIE LEYLAX (4) races best with his runs spaced and loves rain affected going. Comes back in trip after he faded in the run to finish ninth to Saint George over 2000m at Flemington. Gets a better setup for this with the senior rider going on. BOLD MAC (8) fourth-up for this and has the ability to run a big race at the good each way odds. Presented at the right time before striking some trouble in the straight with a respectable sixth over 1500m at Rosehill. Proven here and has a sense of timing today. NARBOLD (12) is a genuine type who gets back in his races and needs plenty of luck. Drawn out and stays in the calculations.
